name: Old Rascals
description: KLM is a welcoming karaoke bar known for its friendly staff and warm atmosphere. It offers a lively environment where both locals and travelers can enjoy singing their favorite songs, making everyone feel at home. The venue features a variety of activities like trivia nights and darts, with a focus on creating a fun, community-oriented experience. Its inviting vibe and consistent karaoke nights make it a great spot for relaxation and entertainment.
